items: Knife or sharp weapon to cut through a web
enemies: Kolodion in 5 forms, up to level 112
rewards: Ability to unlock 3 new God Spells.

st.t: Go to the Mage Arena in the deep Wilderness. The quickest way is the lever in the Edgeville ruins, or the one in the small building near the gate to West Ardougne: both teleport you to the Deserted Keep. Run north, cut the web with your knife or slash weapon, then go west to the small broken-down house north-west of the arena. Cut the webs inside and pull the lever on its wall. This is IN THE WILDERNESS, so don't bring anything you don't want to lose.
i: Knife or sharp weapon to cut through a web
Knife or sharp weapon to cut through a web

st.t: Talk to Kolodion, ready for fighting him in the Mage Arena.
Defeat Kolodion's 5 forms using Magic, the only style that hurts him. Protect from Magic blocks his attacks.
Pray at the statue of the god whose cape you want. Pick up the cape which appears.
Talk to the Chamber Guardian for your staff.
